elements.element: Cap limb (a) measured by fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim" — 'all amounts' is not the fee basis and the anchor is an event, not the claim

elements.element: Cap expressed as the greater of the two limbs and mutual
elements.evidence: "each Party's total aggregate liability ... The cap is mutual and applies regardless of the form of action or number of claims."
No exclusion-of-damages language appears in 21.1 or the supplied definitions; only "total aggregate liability" cap text is present

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality, data-protection and security obligations
elements.evidence: 21.3 "a Party's breach of confidentiality, data-protection, or security obligations"; 21.1 "Except for Excluded Claims"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for gross negligence, wilful misconduct and fraud
Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: 21.3 "infringement or misappropriation of the other Party's intellectual property"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not 'damages' for cap purposes
elements.evidence: 21.3 "Customer's obligation to pay undisputed Fees for conforming Services is not damages" — limited to undisputed Fees for conforming Services, not payment obligations generally
Redline substitutes "the greater of (a) all amounts ... and (b) USD 1,000,000", not a 12 months' fees cap

elements.element: Carve-outs at least for indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct
elements.evidence: 21.3 covers "confidentiality ... indemnification obligations; gross negligence, wilful misconduct" and 21.1 excepts Excluded Claims

reasons: The fee limb was rendered as "all amounts paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement" rather than the playbook's fee basis, and it is anchored to "the event giving rise to the claim" instead of the 12 months preceding the claim; both deviate from the preferred wording.
The USD 1,000,000 floor and the greater-of structure are correctly inserted, and mutuality is preserved by the untouched second sentence.

The carve-out set in 21.3 already delivers every preferred uncapped category (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, other party's IP), so no further edit was needed there.

The 'payment obligations are not damages' element remains unmet: 21.3 covers only "undisputed Fees for conforming Services", which is narrower than Customer's payment obligations generally; a short edit to that sentence was required.
No mutual exclusion of indirect/consequential damages appears in the supplied operative text, so this preferred element cannot be confirmed.

The edit is a single targeted replacement of the cap formula, introduces no undefined terms or dangling mechanics, and leaves the remainder of 21.1 and the definitions effective, so minimality and intent are preserved.
